Its length proves all Tjurina strata. Checks for 38 exact rational cases agree, without being used as an infinite proof. The theorem explicitly limits its domain to the coefficient family.

The proof computes all local embedded deformation tangent dimensions and their exact locally closed loci, plus the full relative module Hilbert function; the highest Jacobian-trivial first-order perturbation still has positive nonlinear defect. These structural phenomena are meaningful in explicit equisingular deformation studies and are not just one arbitrary isolated invariant or an unmotivated numerical example.
